stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,ast_alias AS alias,ast_module AS module,ast_value AS value,ast_value_kind AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(ast_breadth_order,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(ast_index,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(ast_end,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,ast_op AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,ast_context AS context,ast_name_repr AS name_repr,ast_value_repr AS value_repr,ast_annotation AS annotation,ast_annotation_repr AS annotation_repr,CAST(NULLIF(ast_class,'') AS INTEGER) AS cls,CAST(NULLIF(ast_level,'') AS INTEGER) AS level FROM canonical

stages.name: single_decorators
stages.query: SELECT d.__path,d.parent fn,d.id root,coalesce(c.kind,d.kind) kind,coalesce(c.name,d.name) name FROM a d LEFT JOIN a c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.parent=d.id AND c.field='func' AND d.kind='Call' WHERE d.field='decorator_list'

cases._non_docstring_stmts: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'HELPER' AS issue,'Native AST helper result' AS message,n.id||':HELPER:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,n.id node_id,n.id helper_value FROM a n WHERE n.parent=(SELECT CAST(json_extract(data,'$.owner') AS INTEGER) FROM helper_parameters) AND n.field='body' AND NOT (n.kind='Expr' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a value WHERE value.__path=n.__path AND value.parent=n.id AND value.field='value' AND value.kind='Constant' AND value.value_kind='str'))
cases._decorator_names: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'HELPER' AS issue,'Native AST helper result' AS message,n.id||':HELPER:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,n.id node_id,d.name helper_value FROM a n JOIN single_decorators d ON d.__path=n.__path AND d.root=n.id WHERE d.fn=(SELECT CAST(json_extract(data,'$.owner') AS INTEGER) FROM helper_parameters) AND d.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') GROUP BY d.name
cases._find_class: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'HELPER' AS issue,'Native AST helper result' AS message,n.id||':HELPER:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,n.id node_id,n.id helper_value FROM a n WHERE n.kind='ClassDef' AND n.parent=(SELECT CAST(json_extract(data,'$.owner') AS INTEGER) FROM helper_parameters) AND n.field='body' AND n.name=(SELECT json_extract(data,'$.symbol') FROM helper_parameters) ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 1
cases._find_last_method: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'HELPER' AS issue,'Native AST helper result' AS message,n.id||':HELPER:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,n.id node_id,n.id helper_value FROM a n WHERE n.kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef') AND n.parent=(SELECT CAST(json_extract(data,'$.owner') AS INTEGER) FROM helper_parameters) AND n.field='body' AND n.name=(SELECT json_extract(data,'$.symbol') FROM helper_parameters) ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1
cases._function_mentions_attr: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'HELPER' AS issue,'Native AST helper result' AS message,n.id||':HELPER:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,n.id node_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a owner JOIN a child ON child.__path=owner.__path AND child.id BETWEEN owner.id AND owner.last WHERE owner.__path=n.__path AND owner.id=(SELECT CAST(json_extract(data,'$.owner') AS INTEGER) FROM helper_parameters) AND child.kind='Attribute' AND child.name=(SELECT json_extract(data,'$.symbol') FROM helper_parameters)) helper_value FROM a n WHERE n.kind='Module'
cases._function_mentions_name: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'HELPER' AS issue,'Native AST helper result' AS message,n.id||':HELPER:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,n.id node_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a owner JOIN a child ON child.__path=owner.__path AND child.id BETWEEN owner.id AND owner.last WHERE owner.__path=n.__path AND owner.id=(SELECT CAST(json_extract(data,'$.owner') AS INTEGER) FROM helper_parameters) AND child.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') AND child.name=(SELECT json_extract(data,'$.symbol') FROM helper_parameters)) helper_value FROM a n WHERE n.kind='Module'
cases._function_mentions_any_name: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'HELPER' AS issue,'Native AST helper result' AS message,n.id||':HELPER:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,n.id node_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a owner JOIN a child ON child.__path=owner.__path AND child.id BETWEEN owner.id AND owner.last WHERE owner.__path=n.__path AND owner.id=(SELECT CAST(json_extract(data,'$.owner') AS INTEGER) FROM helper_parameters) AND child.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') AND child.name IN (SELECT value FROM helper_parameters,json_each(data,'$.symbols'))) helper_value FROM a n WHERE n.kind='Module'
cases._class_has_assignment: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'HELPER' AS issue,'Native AST helper result' AS message,n.id||':HELPER:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,n.id node_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a assignment JOIN a target ON target.__path=assignment.__path AND target.parent=assignment.id AND target.field='targets' AND target.kind='Name' WHERE assignment.__path=n.__path AND assignment.parent=(SELECT CAST(json_extract(data,'$.owner') AS INTEGER) FROM helper_parameters) AND assignment.field='body' AND assignment.kind='Assign' AND target.name=(SELECT json_extract(data,'$.symbol') FROM helper_parameters)) helper_value FROM a n WHERE n.kind='Module'

relational.query: SELECT files.__path path,0 start_byte,0 end_byte,0 identity,(substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,18)='l2050_transaction/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,18)='l2055_lazy_result/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,20)='l2060_query_builder/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,15)='l2070_batching/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,18)='l4000_permissions/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,23)='l7000_versioned_schema/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,29)='l7200_versioned_transactions/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,30)='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,24)='impl/common/l4100_queue/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,31)='impl/common/l5150_fts_polyfill/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,28)='impl/common/l5200_sql_query/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,32)='impl/common/l5350_hybrid_search/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,37)='impl/common/l7245_versioned_backends/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,45)='impl/common/l7300_sql_versioned_transactions/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,48)='impl/common/l7350_sparse_versioned_transactions/' OR substr(json_extract(data,'$.path'),1,34)='impl/common/l9700_sql_graph_query/') AND NOT (instr('/'||json_extract(data,'$.path'),'/schema/')>0 OR instr('/'||json_extract(data,'$.path'),'_schema/')>0 OR instr('/'||json_extract(data,'$.path'),'/schema_')>0 OR instr('/'||json_extract(data,'$.path'),'/metadata/')>0 OR instr('/'||json_extract(data,'$.path'),'_metadata')>0 OR instr('/'||json_extract(data,'$.path'),'/migration')>0 OR instr('/'||json_extract(data,'$.path'),'/migrations/')>0 OR instr('/'||json_extract(data,'$.path'),'/introspector')>0 OR instr('/'||json_extract(data,'$.path'),'_introspector')>0 OR instr('/'||json_extract(data,'$.path'),'/validator')>0 OR instr('/'||json_extract(data,'$.path'),'_validator')>0 OR instr('/'||json_extract(data,'$.path'),'/capabilit')>0 OR instr('/'||json_extract(data,'$.path'),'/bootstrap')>0 OR instr('/'||json_extract(data,'$.path'),'/tests/')>0) helper_value FROM files,helper_parameters

stages.name: approval_entries
stages.query: SELECT CAST(key AS INTEGER) ordinal,value entry FROM helper_parameters,json_each(data,'$.entries')

relational.query: SELECT files.__path path,0 start_byte,0 end_byte,ordinal*2+0 identity,entry||': approved schema checks must not be internal impl callsites' helper_value FROM files,approval_entries WHERE substr(rx_extract(entry,'\A([^:]*)',1),1,5)='impl/' UNION ALL SELECT files.__path path,0 start_byte,0 end_byte,ordinal*2+1 identity,entry||': approved schema checks must be production user-facing callsites' helper_value FROM files,approval_entries WHERE substr(rx_extract(entry,'\A([^:]*)',1),1,8)='scripts/' OR instr(rx_extract(entry,'\A([^:]*)',1),'/tests/')>0
SELECT __path path,0 start_byte,length(CAST(source_text(__path) AS BLOB)) end_byte,0 identity,syntax_error helper_value FROM syntax

stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,NULL AS alias,ast_module AS module,ast_value AS value,ast_value_kind AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(ast_index,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(ast_end,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,ast_op AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,NULL AS context,NULL AS name_repr,NULL AS value_repr,NULL AS annotation,NULL AS annotation_repr,CAST(NULLIF(ast_class,'') AS INTEGER) AS cls,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS level FROM canonical

stages.name: matching_layers
stages.query: SELECT l.__path,CAST((SELECT group_concat(digit,'') FROM (SELECT d.digit FROM (SELECT 1 position UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4) p JOIN python_decimal_digits d ON rx_matches(substr(l.digits,p.position,1),d.pattern) ORDER BY p.position)) AS INTEGER) layer FROM matching_layer_text l WHERE digits IS NOT NULL

stages.name: matching_imports
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,n.line,CASE WHEN n.kind='ImportFrom' THEN n.module ELSE alias.name END module,coalesce(alias.position,0) ordinal FROM a n LEFT JOIN a alias ON alias.__path=n.__path AND alias.parent=n.id AND alias.kind='alias' AND n.kind='Import' WHERE n.kind IN ('Import','ImportFrom')

stages.name: matching_context
stages.query: SELECT n.*,rx_matches(n.__path,'^(?:applications|application|app)/|(?:^|/)applications/') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM matching_parameters,json_each(data,'$.applicationPaths') WHERE value=n.__path) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM matching_parameters,json_each(data,'$.applicationRoots') WHERE value='' OR substr(n.__path,1,length(value)+1)=value||'/') application,rx_matches(n.__path,'^(?:data_layer/matching\.py$|l1470_matching_contracts/)|(?:^|/)l5250_matching/') production,n.__path IN ('data_layer/matching.py','l5250_matching/api.py','l5250_matching/__init__.py') facade,substr(n.__path,1,23)='conform/l5250_matching/' conformance,(SELECT layer FROM matching_layers WHERE __path=n.__path) layer,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM matching_imports i WHERE i.__path=n.__path AND (i.module='data_layer.matching' OR rx_matches(i.module,'^l(?:1470_matching_contracts|5250_matching)(?:\.|$)'))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a name WHERE name.__path=n.__path AND name.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') AND name.name IN ('MatchSpec','MatchResult','MatchPhysicalPlanError','MatchAccessMethodKind')) uses_contracts FROM a n WHERE n.kind='Module'

relational.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'HELPER' AS issue,'Native matching contract use' AS message,n.id||':HELPER:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,n.uses_contracts helper_value FROM matching_context n WHERE n.kind='Module'
